# Parameter reference

Every Planet is driven by one flat parameter object (the same keys the studio
edits). Pass them to the constructor (`new Planet({ radius: 3000 })`), change
them live with `planet.set({...})`, read them with `planet.get(key)`.

- **Colours** are sRGB albedos in 0–1: `[r, g, b]`, or `'#rrggbb'`, `0xrrggbb`, `THREE.Color`.
- **Ranges** are the studio slider ranges — a sensible envelope, not a hard limit.
- **Structural** keys rebuild the terrain LOD world (not a per-frame operation).
- The three domains are independent: a gas giant ignores the terrestrial keys and vice versa, so
  one parameter object can hold all three looks (`mode` picks the one rendered).

## Terrestrial planets

### General

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `'planet'` |  | Body type: 'planet' (terrestrial), 'gas' or 'star'. Prefer the Planet `type` option. |
| `renderVersion` | number | `3` |  | Look-model version of the parameter set (used to migrate old studio projects). Leave as is. |
| `seed` | number | `1337` |  | Random seed: every procedural field (terrain, clouds, bands, spots) derives from it. |

### Planet

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number | `2000` | 600 – 6000 | Planet radius in local units (world units at scale 1). |
| `heightScale` | number | `80` | 20 – 400 | Terrain relief: height of the highest peaks above the base radius, in local units. |
| `seaLevel` | number | `0.42` | 0 – 0.9 | Sea level, as a fraction of heightScale above the base radius. |

### Noise

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `noiseScale` | number | `2.6` | 0.5 – 8 | Base frequency of the continent noise (higher = more, smaller landmasses). |
| `octaves` | number (structural) | `6` | 3 – 8 | Compile-time define (material rebuild) — Rebuilds the shaders |
| `persistence` | number | `0.52` | 0.3 – 0.7 | Amplitude falloff between noise octaves (higher = rougher terrain). |
| `lacunarity` | number | `2.05` | 1.5 – 3 | Frequency step between noise octaves. |
| `warp` | number | `0.65` | 0 – 2 | Domain warp strength: folds and twists coastlines and ranges. |
| `continents` | number | `0.75` | 0 – 1 | Shapes broad ocean basins and coherent landmasses (Earth-like hypsometry). |

### Mountains & craters

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ridge` | number | `0.55` | 0 – 1.5 | Strength of the ridged mountain ranges along tectonic belts. |
| `mountainScale` | number | `2.4` | 1 – 6 | Frequency of the mountain ridges. |
| `craters` | number | `0` | 0 – 1 | Impact crater amount (0 = none). |
| `craterScale` | number | `6` | 2 – 16 | Crater frequency (higher = smaller craters). |

### Lighting

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sunAzimuth` | number | `100` | 0 – 360 | Degrees (3/4 light from the default camera) |
| `sunElevation` | number | `18` | -30 – 90 | Sun elevation |
| `sunIntensity` | number | `1` | 0.2 – 2.5 | Sun intensity |
| `ambient` | number | `0.25` | 0 – 0.8 | Sky light strength — Diffuse light from the sky dome (fades out on the night side) |
| `exposure` | number | `1` | 0.3 – 3 | Camera exposure before the filmic tone map |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gasBandCount` | number | `18` | 2 – 32 | Belts + zones, pole to pole |

| `gasBandWarp` | number | `0.5` | 0 – 1.5 | Band edge waviness — How much the band edges meander |
| `gasPolarHaze` | number | `0.55` | 0 – 1 | Polar region extent / haze — Banding dissolves into cyclones under a haze toward the poles |
